summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K for November 2026 furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the period ended September 30, 2026, incorporated by reference into its F-10, F-3D and S-8 registration statements. No transaction event is disclosed. Reported figures show a third-quarter net loss of $660 million versus $431 million net income a year earlier, driven by an $800 million impairment of intangible assets and goodwill, with nine-month impairment reaching $2,935 million. Basic and diluted loss per share were $0.42. No special-situation terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are present; nothing for a risk-arb angle.
